description: Eversource: EV Hosting Capacity (Connecticut) is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. This map provides some guidance on an approximate value of Hosting Capacity measured in MegaWatts (MW) that may be accommodated onto a particular point on the distribution system. The EV hosting capacity map can be found under "How can I understand Connecticut’s existing electrical hosting capacity?" in the link listed in reference field. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Transportation. Its keywords are hosting capacity maps, hosting capacity. The portal shows 2025-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is No license, or terms of use, asserted by data producer for this dataset was found.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
